experiment: R2b closed-loop Space switch with permissions (follow-up to r2-switch-observations.json)
scope: Single arm64 macOS 27.0.1 (26A434), SIP enabled, two displays. Probe is an ad-hoc signed ClosedLoopProbe started directly from the shell (no open), so the terminal app (Warp) is the TCC responsible process; no other app identity was used and no TCC database, keychain or main repository file was touched. Disposable fixtures only; no screenshots (screen recording not granted). The bridged SetCurrentSpace operation was removed from the probe; bridged window placement is still used to put the witness fixture on the target Space. Restore uses only B1 (activate the origin fixture) or the temporarily enabled system hotkeys.

verdictRules.attemptPass: Signals 1 (workspace notification, controller or fixture process), 2 (fixture self-report) and 3 (CG on-screen list) must hold together after a 300 ms stability recheck. Non-empty target: target fixture isOnActiveSpace+occlusionVisible and origin fixture off; CG lists target, not origin. Empty target: origin and witness fixtures both off and absent from the CG list, PLUS signal 3b arrival proof. Signal 4 (F19 delivered to the frontmost app, only if it is a fixture) must pass whenever applicable: target fixture receives it and origin does not.
verdictRules.signal3b: A windowless "arrival" fixture creates a new window after the switch; a new window of a windowless app lands on the real active Space of the ACTIVE display. It is validated on non-empty targets where the target fixture proves arrival, and is decisive for empty targets only if validated. It is meaningful only for Spaces of the display that currently hosts the key focus (display 0 in this setup); on display 1 it is informational and always landed on display 0.
verdictRules.signal4: The frontmost app gets up to 1.5 s to settle. If it is not a fixture, nothing is posted (never type into user apps) and the attempt is marked inputEvidence=false; its verdict is then a switch-only pass. For empty targets the target fixture cannot exist, so signal 4 is not applicable.
verdictRules.signal5: SLSManagedDisplayGetCurrentSpace is auxiliary and never counts.
verdictRules.pathVerdict: pass = every executed attempt passed; fail = every attempt failed; inconclusive = mixed, blocked or skipped. One attempt per path and scenario (time cap).
verdictRules.pathVerdictInputQualifier: A path whose pass attempts all had inputEvidence=false is reported as pass-switch-only.
verdictRules.overallVerdict: pass = at least one path pass; fail = every tested path failed; inconclusive otherwise.

timing.budgetNote: Retest budget 180 s across all runs: run1 23.5 s + run2 25.9 s + S3 rerun 10.3 s of probe runtime (wall time incl. setup 41 s + 50 s + 10 s)

preCheck.orderObservation: Display 1 (UUID ending ...B230): Spaces [1,5], current 1. Display 2 (UUID ending ...462B): Spaces [46,7,6], current 7. Space 54 from the previous round no longer exists, and the order is not the previous [46,7,54,6]; the user changed the layout before this round. During the session the current Space of display 2 was seen as 46 once and 7 afterwards, i.e. the user was switching desktops between calls. All Spaces are type 0 (normal).

supersededFirstPass.reason: The first execution of run1/run2 is not used for the table: (a) the arrival proof for empty targets used a fixture that already owned a window on the origin Space, so its new window always joined the origin Space (S2 reported fail for the wrong reason); (b) the Desktop number for D was local to the display, while the system numbers Desktops globally across displays, so Control+2 and Control+3 on display 2 acted on display 1 and left display 1 on Space 5; (c) the S3 D attempt reused a Desktop number computed before an earlier activation reordered the Spaces.
supersededFirstPass.sideEffectAndRecovery: After the first pass display 1 was left on Space 5 (current 5 instead of 1). It was returned to Space 1 with B1 only (origin fixture moved to Space 1 and activated); no hotkey, no bridged setter. Structure verified afterwards.
supersededFirstPass.kept: Raw first-pass files are in the temp build directory only; the facts above are the only retained information.

inputRoutingFindings: B1, B2 and D deliver the harmless F19 to the target fixture every time (target received 1, origin 0).

A on display 1 also routed F19 to the target; on display 2 the frontmost app after Control-Right was not a fixture even after 1.5 s, so nothing was posted. A therefore proves the switch but not focus handoff on display 2.
After any switch to an empty desktop the frontmost app is another app (not a fixture), so keyboard input there goes to that app, not to anything Switchly controls.

desktopNumbering.finding: Symbolic hotkeys 118-126 use GLOBAL Desktop numbers across displays in display enumeration order: display 1 owns Desktops 1-2 (Spaces [1,5]), display 2 owns Desktops 3-5 (Spaces [46,7,6]). The key acts on the display that owns the Nth Desktop, regardless of cursor or key-window display (cursor was warped to the target display before each press). Numbers follow the CURRENT Space order, which changes under MRU reordering.
desktopNumbering.staleNumberExperiment: In the superseded first pass Control+5 was pressed for Space 6 after the order had become [46,6,7]; Desktop 5 then pointed at a different Space and the attempt failed signals 2/3 (the workspace notification still fired). Recomputing the number at press time fixed it (rerun passed with Desktop 4).

autoRearrange.mru-spaces: unset (system default: automatic rearrange); not modified
autoRearrange.trigger: Activating (B1) the app on non-adjacent Space 6 from 46 changed display 2 order from [46,7,6] to [46,6,7] at arrival, in two independent runs. Adjacent switches (A, B1, B2, D to 7, and all display 1 switches) did not reorder. D to 6 after the reorder (desktop 4) left the order alone. Returning to 7 as the final restore put the order back to [46,7,6] in the main run.
autoRearrange.caveat: Observed on one machine; ordering after multi-step round trips is not predictable enough to cache by index. Bind Spaces by ID.

hotkeys.backup: ~/Library/Preferences/com.apple.symbolichotkeys.plist copied to $TMPDIR/desktop-grid-r2b/hotkeys-backup/ together with a defaults export
hotkeys.restoreMethod: defaults import of the exported backup, then activateSettings -u; the wrapper traps EXIT/INT/TERM/HUP; verified after every invocation (HOTKEYS_RESTORED_VERIFIED=yes x3). Keys 79-82 stayed {enabled: true}; plist content equals the backup byte-for-structure.

finalState.displayDriftRecovered: display 1 current drifted to 5 after the superseded first pass and was returned to 1 with B1

limits: One machine and build, two displays, small number of attempts (1 per path/scenario) so no failure rate is claimed.
Screen recording not granted; no screenshots; empty-desktop arrival rests on the arrival fixture (validated on 5 non-empty display-1 attempts).
Empty non-adjacent desktop and moving-and-following (window move plus switch) were not tested; no such desktop existed and bridged moves are not a product path.
The first-pass runs were discarded for harness defects, not for system behavior.
